evidence: A repeatable way to activate creators, with the targets stated up front rather than negotiated each time.
**Targets, per creator.** 1 blog / long post · 3–5 social updates over ~14 days · 2–3 posts per day during a live challenge · an agreed number of pieces committed up front
cross_source: Platform differentiates professional influencers (journalists, analysts, named experts) from power-middle semi-pro creators. Roadmap Month10 is earned outreach.
conclusion: Do not apply contracted publishing quotas to independent editorial coverage. A measurement of creator commitments must state its activated-creator population and live-challenge condition, preserve the agreed-piece dependency, and not invent that such activity or agreements already exist.
launch_gap: Toolkit Month4 launch names earned coverage quality; existing quality measure is Month10 only.
